source.title: Pickers_Hollow_Warm_Wood_Tab_Click_Source
source.original_idea: ok I want a more drawn wood clicking sound, little warmer, for the tab headers, give me the preview in the standard folder. Separate tab header preview only, final 150 ms, standard Audio Studio outputs directory, no tab integration before review.
source.prompt: A single warm wooden switch click with a slightly drawn-out grainy wooden contact and a rounded soft knock, followed by a short mellow woody resonance that settles smoothly. Close-miked, dry, tactile and restrained.
source.prompt_used: TrackType: SFX, A single warm wooden switch click with a slightly drawn-out grainy wooden contact and a rounded soft knock, followed by a short mellow woody resonance that settles smoothly.
